runtime: actual Next /dev route and production scene components
scope: Direct travel, real movement and mission startup, Wolf castle rooms and approach, eight planetary arrivals with natural and skipped handoffs, reset, URL entry, keyboard and touch, and campaign storage isolation. No complete campaign, art approval or performance qualification.

checks.name: Hidden /dev route opens directly with noindex and a complete destination catalogue
Category and accent-insensitive search filter actual destination buttons
Keyboard launch opens the real personal deck, movement works, and reset restores the starting point
Changing equipment in the test armory stays in memory and returning preserves the personal deck
All seven Clan Ship room arrivals mount the real interior and their authored scenery
Approach, docking and boarding use the real Clan Ship transitions within the test session
Homeworld port and market open at distinct real city positions, and city movement works
A regional destination opens its live village, and F8 returns to the catalogue even from its modal
All nine Wolf castle arrivals render their real rooms, accept movement and reset the disposable visit
Wolf approach, boarding, settings and departure use native actions, and F8 escapes its real map
All eight arrival entries preload their native resources and identify the correct mission, planet, hunter and ship
Arrival pause, mobile controls, reload, reset and native Skip preserve the campaign and enter one real hunt
A full natural arrival presents all eight shots and hands the same mission to one real hunt without storage writes
A real mission keeps its position and clock after walking into a newly discovered room
Direct bookmarked room URLs and reload recreate a disposable session
Unknown destination is recoverable through the catalogue
Mobile catalogue and Clan Ship support touch at 390 px without horizontal overflow
An empty browser can visit and reset a real room without creating any save or database
Leaving development returns to the ordinary game menu with no developer navigation entry
Visited development scenes produce no missing asset, uncaught JavaScript exception or storage write
